# Carolina De La Cerda

## Profile
Scientist specializing in molecular diagnostics, assay development, and infectious disease detection at Cepheid.

## Areas of Expertise
- Molecular Diagnostics
- Assay Development
- Infectious Disease Detection
- PCR and qPCR Technologies

## Known For
- Developing and validating molecular diagnostic assays for infectious disease detection
- Leading verification and validation studies for multiplex detection panels
- Technology transfer of assays from development to manufacturing
